articles.title: From Brooklyn to Milan: The 26 Americans Carrying a Nation's World Cup Hopes
articles.summary: The U.S. men's World Cup roster blends global experience and redemption stories. Christian Pulisic leads a squad featuring dual-nationals and a striker who scored 19 goals this season. Their journey starts Friday against Paraguay.

articles.title: U.S.-Iran Deal 'Closer Than Ever' as Pakistan Mediates Final Text
articles.summary: Pakistan's prime minister says a final peace text has been agreed between the U.S. and Iran. The potential deal would swap sanctions relief for nuclear dismantlement. Trump says it could be signed this weekend, but Iranian leadership must still consent.

articles.title: Section 702 Lapses: Why a Key U.S. Spy Tool Is in Limbo
articles.summary: Congress let Section 702 of FISA expire on Friday, leaving a crucial surveillance program in legal limbo. The law allows warrantless collection of foreigners' communications but sweeps up Americans' data. Political infighting over a Trump nominee stalled renewal.
